subject.title: Add optional `name`/`label` field to group config entries

question: Should OpenClaw add persistent metadata to opaque channel group entries, and which canonical field name and entry scope should become part of the public config contract?
rationale: The request is useful but adds compatibility-sensitive configuration surface across multiple channel owners; source inspection cannot choose whether the durable contract should be scoped metadata or a universal field, nor whether `name` would be confused with functional resolution.

options.title: Add scoped `label` metadata
options.body: Add an optional `label` string only to opaque identifier-keyed group or channel entries, preserve it in config tooling, and ignore it at runtime.

options.title: Add universal metadata
options.body: Add a canonical field to every group, topic, guild, and channel entry for uniformity, accepting a broader public configuration surface.

options.title: Keep external annotations
options.body: Decline new config surface and rely on JSON5 comments plus channel-specific lookup and resolution workflows.

recommendation.title: Add scoped `label` metadata
recommendation.body: Add an optional `label` string only to opaque identifier-keyed group or channel entries, preserve it in config tooling, and ignore it at runtime.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest combined central-schema history, repository ownership signal, and direct engagement with this issue.
